summary: PARTIAL is right. Commit 60633eff3 (#710, which the Hub's vendored 7bc39eec3 also contains) replaced the per-row full status with a `view: "summary"` stream. HEAD is read from disk with no status, diff or fetch. The PR comes from a shared per-repository index (gh pr list, limit 100, 60 s, single-flight). The broadcaster cache is LRU-bounded to 256 folders, and the shared sliding(64) PubSub is now one channel per folder. Background git and gh spawns are also capped by the process governor. So the ~40-44 spawns, fetch and status chain per folder are gone. Three gaps remain. (1) GitManager.findLatestPr still makes one or more `gh pr list --head` calls per branch whenever the index cannot answer. This is common in repos with more than 100 PRs, Ryco's own included, for old merged branches or pushed branches without a PR, and it breaks the '<=1 gh per repo' goal. (2) A cold folder still costs about 3-4 git spawns (rev-parse detect, config --list, remote -v, and for-each-ref when there is no upstream). The proposal targeted about 0-1. (3) The batched channel, fs.watch and projection-sourced worktree PRs were not built. The auditor missed two smaller items: the command palette mounts summary streams for every rendered thread with no visibility gating, and project roots below the repository root lose the spawn-free HEAD path.

evidence.note: Rows call useGitStatus(..., { enabled: shouldEnableSidebarRowGitStatus({isActive, isIntersecting}), view: "summary" }). This view is the only git status a sidebar row reads.
Inbox rows also use the summary view. Full status (line 214) is read only while hover or focus intent is active.

streamRefSummary runs workflow.refSummary in inBackgroundProcessLane. It re-reads on a per-folder publication, a 5 s HEAD file poll (line 717) and an optional poll of at least 60 s. Lines 754-755 dispatch on input.view. Test VcsStatusBroadcaster.test.ts:998 asserts no local/remote/fetch calls.

readRefSummary gets the branch and origin/HEAD from readCheckoutHead (a disk read), uses the cached config snapshot, probeBranchPublished, then findLatestPr. It does no status, diff or fetch. Lines 1821-1828 cache it 30 s per cwd + branch read from disk.

Per-repository index: limit 100, 60 s TTL (10 s on failure), capacity 256, single-flight through Cache.get, keyed by provider and normalized remote URL. lookupIndexedChangeRequest (line 186) returns resolved:false when the recent list is full and has no match.

Residual: when the index is unresolved, findLatestPr loops over head selectors with listChangeRequests (state all, limit 20), one gh call each, with no cache beyond refSummary's 30 s. GitManager.test.ts:1610-1614 pins the sequence for an old branch: pr list all + pr list open + pr list --head.

STATUS_CACHE_MAX_FOLDERS=256 (LRU through withCachedFolder, line 232). FOLDER_CHANNEL_CAPACITY=16 per-folder PubSub (subscribeFolder/publishFolderEvent, lines 183-229) replaces the shared sliding(64).
The background lane caps concurrent git children at 8 and gh/glab/az at 4, so a first-render burst queues instead of spawning hundreds at once.

Residual spawn: detectProviderContext runs `git remote -v` (GitVcsDriver.ts:592) per folder, cached only 5 s (line 33). The config snapshot (`git config -z --list`, GitVcsDriverCore.ts:1145, TTL 5 s at line 79) already holds remote.*.url. Detect (rev-parse) is cached 2 min (VcsDriverRegistry.ts:20).
Residual spawn: probeBranchPublished runs `git for-each-ref refs/remotes/<r>/<branch>` when the branch has no upstream config.

Missed caller: ThreadRowLeadingStatus subscribes the summary view with no `enabled` gating. CommandPaletteDialog.tsx:1045 and 1076 render it for every thread item, and CommandPaletteResults.tsx:43 renders the whole Base UI collection (not virtualized). A broad query therefore opens one summary stream per distinct folder of all matching threads (about 53 for the user). It was full view before, so this is better, but still ungated.

A project cwd below the repository root returns null. readRefSummary then spawns two `git symbolic-ref` (GitManager.ts:1722-1737 and 1765-1780). The summary stream's HEAD poll (VcsStatusBroadcaster.ts:717-723) always yields null for such a folder, so a checkout switch made outside Ryco is not noticed until a publication arrives or the row resubscribes after the 30 s TTL.

useGitStatus also passes the user's gitStatusPollIntervalMs to summary streams. The default is 0, so this is off. When the user enables it, every visible folder re-reads the summary at most once every 60 s, past the 30 s refSummary cache: config, remote -v and the per-branch gh fallback.
Worktree headers render projection PR data (prNumber/prState). Thread rows in those worktrees still open their own summary stream instead of reading the projection.

remaining:
1. Per-branch gh fallback on the badge path (GitManager.ts:1246-1281, reached from readRefSummary at GitManager.ts:1793-1808). In a repository with more than 100 change requests, the index cannot answer for a published branch whose PR falls outside the recent 100 (old merged worktrees) or that has no PR. Each such folder then costs 1-3 `gh pr list --head` calls on every cold refSummary read (30 s cache; rows resubscribe on visibility changes), queued behind the 4-slot forge pool. Ryco's own repo (more than 700 PRs) is exactly this case. The same fallback also runs when the index listing itself failed (offline, no auth), where the per-branch calls fail the same way.
2. Not spawn-free: a cold folder costs rev-parse detect (2 min cache), `git config -z --list` (5 s), `git remote -v` (5 s) and, without an upstream, `git for-each-ref`. That is about 3-4 per folder, roughly 90-120 for 30 folders, versus the proposed 0-30. Project roots below the repository root add 2 `symbolic-ref` spawns and get no HEAD-change detection (gitCheckoutHead.ts:47, VcsStatusBroadcaster.ts:717).
3. The command palette mounts ungated summary streams for every rendered thread row (ThreadStatusIndicators.tsx:145 via CommandPaletteDialog.tsx:1045/1076).
4. Optional, not done: a batched `subscribeSummaries({cwds})` channel (each visible folder is still its own RPC stream plus a 5 s HEAD poll), fs.watch on HEAD, and projection pull_requests for worktree-thread rows.
Adjacent but outside this finding's VCS-status scope: in inbox mode, each visible row with a PR also issues an uncached getChangeRequestDetail (InboxThreadRow.tsx:219 to sourceControlRpc.ts:585), polled every 30 s while the PR is open. This should be tracked separately if wanted.
fixDefects: No regression found. Minor: (a) the first summary snapshot (VcsStatusBroadcaster.ts:708) waits for the whole readSummary, including a cold index gh call or the per-branch fallback, so even the spawn-free refName arrives only after gh. (b) refSummaryKeysByCwd (GitManager.ts:1716) remembers only the latest branch key per cwd, so after a checkout switch the old branch's entry lives until its TTL (harmless). (c) In the HEAD-poll stream, Stream.changes + drop(1) on the first immediate tick can swallow a switch that happens between the initial read and the first tick (a millisecond window). (d) For a non-root project cwd, isDefaultRef falls back to the main/master heuristic when origin/HEAD is missing, which can differ from the full path's base-branch resolution (an edge case).
implementationSketch:
A. Bound the gh fallback (main value). In GitManager.ts add a `branchChangeRequestCache` (Effect Cache, capacity about 2048) keyed by `pullRequestIndexRepositoryKey + headSelector`. Its lookup runs the existing per-selector listChangeRequests. TTL depends on the result: open 60 s, merged/closed 15 min, none 2-5 min, failure 10 s. Use it inside findLatestPr (lines 1259-1275) for both the summary and full paths. invalidatePullRequestIndex (line 1170) should also invalidate that repository's entries, which an explicit refresh or git action already triggers. In lookupIndexedChangeRequest (pullRequestIndex.ts:186) distinguish `unavailable` (listing failed) from `incomplete`, and skip the per-branch loop when it is unavailable (return null; the 10 s failure TTL retries). Tests in GitManager.test.ts: two refSummary reads of an old branch on separate checkouts of the same repo, with the cache invalidated in between, issue at most one `--head` call within the TTL; a failing `pr list --state all` causes no `--head` call; an explicit invalidateRemoteStatus re-asks.
B. Fewer spawns per cold folder (optional). (1) In SourceControlProviderRegistry.detectProviderContext (line 682), build remotes from gitCore.readConfigSnapshot (`remote.<name>.url`/`pushurl`), applying `url.<base>.insteadOf`/`pushInsteadOf` from the same snapshot, and fall back to `remote -v` only when the snapshot is unavailable. (2) In probeBranchPublished (GitManager.ts:904), check `<commonDir>/refs/remotes/<remote>/<branch>` and packed-refs (commonDir from readCheckoutHead) before running for-each-ref; reftable keeps the spawn. (3) Revalidate the config snapshot by stat (mtime/size of <commonDir>/config and <gitDir>/config.worktree) instead of the 5 s TTL. (4) For a cwd below the root, resolve the root once (cached with detect) and run readCheckoutHead on the root, which restores the HEAD poll and drops the symbolic-ref spawns. Test with spawn counters in GitManager.test.ts and VcsStatusBroadcaster.test.ts: a cold summary costs at most 1 git spawn (detect).
C. Gate the palette. Give ThreadRowLeadingStatus (ThreadStatusIndicators.tsx:145) an `enabled` option. In CommandPaletteDialog pass enabled only for the first RECENT_THREAD_LIMIT rendered items or the highlighted one, or add a `useGitStatusSnapshot(target, 'summary')` that reads the existing atom without watching, so palette rows reuse badges the sidebar already loaded. Browser test: a palette query with N threads opens at most 12 vcs subscriptions.
D. Optional: worktree-thread rows read the projection's pull_requests (already in SidebarWorktreeList) and skip the stream; a batched `vcs.subscribeSummaries({cwds})` RPC with fs.watch on HEAD.
decisionReason: Internal caching and spawn work only: no auth, E2EE, Hub protocol or hosted-lifecycle change. Part A keeps the current badge behaviour by caching instead of dropping the per-branch lookup; only if someone chose to skip that lookup on the sidebar path (old merged PR badges would disappear) would a product decision be needed.
correction: No change to the status. The auditor missed two items: the ungated summary subscriptions in the command palette (ThreadStatusIndicators.tsx:145 via CommandPaletteDialog.tsx:1045/1076), and project cwds below the repository root, where gitCheckoutHead returns null, which costs 2 extra symbolic-ref spawns and disables HEAD-change detection. They also did not mention that the process governor (git 8 / forge 4 background slots) bounds the burst, or that the per-branch fallback also fires when the index listing itself fails.
